{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display basic info: dtypes, missing values, shape
info = sales_df.info()

# Check unique values in 'channel' column
unique_channels = sales_df['channel'].unique()

# Check conversion rate overall
overall_conversion_rate = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Return all
(top_rows, info, unique_channels, overall_conversion_rate)"}
